implementation: GPU partition preserves the original unique selected cell identities. Floating eligible cells reserve from the front and integer fallback cells from the back of the same count-sized output using two globally aggregated counts. No selector or dot arithmetic is changed.

Variant0 uses original four-lane/one-group replay and original cell order; variant1 uses the same math with GPU partition; variant2 uses the previously certified range arithmetic with partition; variant3 uses range arithmetic with original ordering. Each uses one warmup and one timed completed sequence including common range metadata, raw accumulator writes and, when active, zeroed partition counters and GPU partition. Allocation, uploads, CPU candidate selection and CPU verification are outside that component timing.

All 24 generated partition cases cover empty, single, partial/full CTA and multiple CTA lengths through65539 with all-integer,all-floating and mixed flags. Native tests require exact permutation, contiguous class order, exact counts, immutable inputs and redzones.

The real replay compares all58728448 original GB10 BF16 cells and3791742 unrounded FP32 candidate values. Partitioned raw values are sorted by original cell identity for comparison, proving both candidate preservation and exact values. Original PPB1000 remains unchanged and reference tensors are comparison-only.
conclusions: All local checks pass:375 Python tests with2 skips,47 Rust tests,C smoke,clippy and public hygiene. Native builds and all24 permutation cases pass with guards and source inputs intact.

All four real QKV variants preserve the external58728448 BF16 cells and3791742 raw FP32 candidate values. Partition counts are3028041 floating and763701 integer. Every identity and class position is checked.

Original/unmodified arithmetic takes50.8645ms interleaved and43.2025ms partitioned, a7.6620ms single-component reduction including GPU partition. Range arithmetic takes48.3263ms interleaved and39.7011ms partitioned. This supports a product experiment but is not an accepted product or repeatability result.

Next integrate candidate grouping into dense and MoE product collectors/replay with original arithmetic and original PPB1000 bounds, then require all512 original q8192 GB10 outputs and actual callbacks. Range normalization remains outside product dispatch during that comparison.
